svg.text: Body (protective) earths and the transformer neutral go to separate pit groups — never joined
LV ROOM — MDB-1 MAIN EARTH BAR
TN-S: one N–E link at the MDB; sub-board earths and bonding on the main earth bar
Neutral earth to its own pit; frame, fuel tank and enclosure bonded through the generator earth bar
EP-GEN-01 above 1 Ω: add an electrode
Continues to the next pit / panel
1. Transformer neutral and body earths go to separate
pit groups and are never joined.
2. Pits of one group are interconnected; pits of
different groups at least 6 m apart.
3. Each pit ≤ 1 Ω, measured before energisation;
values above 1 Ω are flagged in Checks.
4. One N–E link only, at the main board (TN-S).
5. Every earth bar has a test link to its pits.
6. Conductor sizes from the earthing calculation.
Sample project — concept only, not for construction
Substation 1: RMU, transformer, LV room and standby generator
